 Porto 4 – 0 Estoril Praia Froholdt 4' Sainz 64' Silva 70' Veiga 73' FULL TIME Gabri Veiga shines as unbeaten Porto routs Estoril Praia 4-0 in Liga Portugal
 Porto defeated Estoril Praia 4-0 in Liga Portugal at Estádio do Dragão. Relive the goals, key highlights, match stats and minute-by-minute recap on VAVEL.
 Coverage by Victor Cunha Updated October 31, 2026, 6:31 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 FULL TIME Last update 6:31 PM ET 6:31 PM ET an hour ago Thanks!
 And that's all for now! Thank you so much for watching this Liga Portugal match, with all the action and excitement here on VAVEL! Stay tuned for updates and upcoming games. Good night and see you next time!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 Key moments
 6:28 PM ET End of match 
 6:10 PM ET 75' Goal by Gabri Veiga · 4-0 
 6:05 PM ET 70' Goal by André Silva · 3-0 
 6:01 PM ET 66' Goal by Borja Sainz · 2-0 
 5:31 PM ET Tactical keys for the second half 
 5:23 PM ET End of first half 
 5:12 PM ET 40' Yellow card 
 4:42 PM ET 10' Goal by Victor Froholdt · 1-0 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 6:28 PM ET an hour ago End of match
 Porto thrash Estoril! In a game dominated from start to finish, Porto wins at home, beating Estoril 4-0, with goals from Froholdt, Borja Sainz, André Silva and Gabri Veiga, to remain undefeated and only winning in the Portugal League!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 90' 6:22 PM ET an hour ago Added time
 Alan Varela received the pass in front and shot from distance, but wide. Afterwards, Xeka also risked a long shot, again out wide. We will have four more minutes of extra time and the game is heading towards a peaceful end with a victory for Porto! And both teams changed in these extra minutes of the match. On the Estoril side, Pedro Carvalho, the one who was in pain a few minutes ago, came out for Ricard Sánchez. In Porto, Alberto Costa left, without injury, for Nehuén Pérez.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 85' 6:18 PM ET an hour ago Turk
 Souza received the ball as Porto exchanged passes in the attacking field to finish from distance, sending the ball into the hands of Turk, who did not rebound. The game was then delayed for Pedro Carvalho, in pain after suffering a foul, back on the pitch.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 80' 6:13 PM ET an hour ago Changes in both teams
 After three goals in 10 minutes, both teams changed. At Estoril, Ferro left for the entrance to Holsgrove. In Porto, Bednarek, Pepê and Gabri Veiga left for Seko Fofana, Gabriel Mec and Alan Varela. Soon after, Omerovic received the pass and scored a strong shot, hitting the crossbar!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 75' 6:10 PM ET an hour ago Goal for Porto
 It turned into a rout! In less than 10 minutes Porto scored three goals, now thanks to Borja Sainz's move to find Gabri Veiga in the area, achieving a strong finish in the left corner, on the ground to send the ball into the back of the goal, with the score 4-0!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 70' 6:05 PM ET an hour ago Goal for Porto
 After the second goal, Porto made another change, leaving Samu Aghehowa for André Silva. And André Silva, in the confusion inside the area, caught the rebound of Gabri Veiga's shot saved by Turk, to send the ball into the back of the goal!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 66' 6:01 PM ET 2 hours ago Goal for Porto
 Gabri Veiga received the pass and found the ball in front for Borja Sainz to shoot into the top of the left corner, extending the score for Porto, who managed to score the second goal in the game, now beating Estoril with more ease!
 🇵🇹 FC Porto 2-0 Estoril Praia
🚨GOAL! ⚽️ 64’ Borja Sainz doubles the lead for Sporting ✅ https://t.co/6xR1dkjWpg
— Ayuba | Football News (@ayubafootball) October 31, 2026 
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 65' 5:57 PM ET 2 hours ago Changes in Estoril
 Bednarek found the pass for Kiwior, who shot powerfully from distance, but sent the ball wide. Now Estoril made two substitutions, with Jordan Arolin, Xavier Sintes and Stelios Andreou leaving and Samuel Amissah, Xeka and Axel Camblan entering.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 60' 5:53 PM ET 2 hours ago Turk
 Bednarek received the pass up front and crossed the ball into the box, where Samu appeared and shot hard, with Martin Turk once again palming it away! Shortly after, Lacximicant had a chance after breaking into the box, but his shot was blocked by the defense.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 55' 5:49 PM ET 2 hours ago Slow start
 Unlike the first half, the second begins at a slower pace, with Porto maintaining possession and Estoril closed in defense, but with no chances created and with the game stopped at two different times for assistance.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 50' 5:45 PM ET 2 hours ago Changes in both teams
 At half-time, Porto made a change to the team, leaving Zaidu Sanusi, with an injury, for Souza. At Estoril, after the start of the second half, Peixinho left, injured, for Naiel Omerovic to enter. Both teams made changes.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 5:43 PM ET 2 hours ago Second half starts
 The players returned to the pitch at Estádio do Dragão and the ball rolled for the second half of the match between Porto and Estoril, in Matchday 10 of the Liga Portugal, with all the action and excitement here on VAVEL!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 5:31 PM ET 2 hours ago Tactical keys for the second half
 Looking ahead to the second half in the Porto vs Estoril Praia live match stats , Porto must be more clinical in the box after registering 62 dangerous attacks, 287 successful passes, and 11 key passes, while Estoril needs to improve their 75% passing accuracy and push higher up the field after generating just four dangerous attacks and zero corners.
 Completed passes (accuracy): Porto 322 (89%) – 146 (75%) Estoril Praia
 Duels won: Porto 19 – 18 Estoril Praia
 Dangerous attacks: Porto 62 – 4 Estoril Praia
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 5:26 PM ET 2 hours ago Half-time statistics
 It was a complete domination by Porto, who had 70% possession of the ball, while Estoril only had 30%. The number of chances is even more overwhelming, with 16 shots from Porto, including five on target, compared to only two from Estoril, who failed to find the net. There were SIXTY-TWO dangerous attacks from Porto against four from Estoril, plus 7 to 0 in corner kicks!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 5:24 PM ET 2 hours ago First-half analysis and key takeaways
 It was a first half dominated by Porto from start to finish, where the home team managed to create the best chances of the game, controlling the match, while Estoril didn't create a single real chance of danger.It was a first half dominated by Porto from start to finish, where the home team managed to create the best chances of the game, controlling the match, while Estoril didn't create a single real chance of danger.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 5:23 PM ET 2 hours ago End of first half
 And we're at halftime! Porto managed to create the best chances and didn't suffer in the first 45 minutes, going into the break leading Estoril 1-0, with a goal from Victor Froholdt early in the Liga Portugal game!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 50' 5:20 PM ET 2 hours ago Blocked
 Sanusi received the pass and shot hard from distance, but sent the ball wide. Soon after, Estoril managed their FIRST shot of the game, where Guitane broke into the area and managed a powerful shot, but it was blocked by the defense.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 45' 5:17 PM ET 2 hours ago Added time
 On the right, Porto won another corner, taken into the area but cleared away by the defense. Porto continues to dominate the match, controlling the pace of the game and pressing, but without managing to finish at the moment. And we will have three more minutes of added time. Updates by Victor Cunha
 40' 5:12 PM ET 2 hours ago Yellow card
 Bednarek received a yellow card for a hard foul on Peixinho. Shortly after, Froholdt found the pass to Pablo Rosario, who shot hard, but straight at the defense, winning a corner kick, which was taken into the area and cleared by the defense.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 35' 5:08 PM ET 2 hours ago Out again!
 Sanusi received the pass up front and took a powerful long-range shot, but it was blocked by the defense. Shortly after, Samu, following up on Sanusi's cross, headed the ball powerfully, but sent it wide to the right of the goal!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 30' 5:03 PM ET 3 hours ago Blocked
 Alberto Costa, on a pass from Kiwior, managed a powerful shot, but Martin Turk palmed the ball away! Shortly after, the play continued until Froholdt got a long-range shot, but it was blocked by the defense once again.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 25' 4:59 PM ET 3 hours ago Turk
 Samu received Alberto Costa's cross and headed the ball powerfully, but it went straight to Turk, who caught the ball without giving up a rebound. Porto continues to dominate the game, controlling the pace and pressing, even with the score at 1-0!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 20' 4:54 PM ET 3 hours ago Blocked
 Pepê found the pass for Samu Aghehowa, who managed a shot, deflected off the defense, resulting in a corner kick. The corner was cleared by the defense. Porto continues to dominate possession, controlling the game and constantly creating dangerous attacks!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 15' 4:48 PM ET 3 hours ago Out
 Pepê got a strong shot off, but Martin Turk parried it for a corner. Gabri Veiga crossed into the box, Bednarek got a touch, but sent the ball over the goal, wide again! Porto are pressing in this early game!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 4:42 PM ET 3 hours ago Goal for Porto
 In a great exchange of passes, Porto arrived in the area, where Pepê received the pass/shot from Borja Sainz on the right of the penalty area, to cross low for Froholdt to get the shot in the small area, into the back of the goal!
 🚨🇵🇹 | GOAL: VICTOR FROHOLDT OPENS THE SCORING FOR PORTO IN JUST 3 MINUTES!
Porto 1-0 Estoril. https://t.co/7exFqsveUL
— TheGoalsZone (@TheGoalsZone) October 31, 2026 Updates by Victor Cunha
 5' 4:37 PM ET 3 hours ago Out
 Right from the start, Lacximicant received a pass from Stelios Andreou and took a powerful shot, but sent the ball wide to the right of the goal! Porto dominated the game from the beginning and managed to exchange passes in the attacking half!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:31 PM ET 3 hours ago Here we go
 The players took to the pitch and the ball rolled for the Porto vs Estoril clash, in the first 45 minutes of this tenth round match of the Liga Portugal, with all the action and excitement of the duel here on VAVEL.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:26 PM ET 3 hours ago Touchline battle: Francesco Farioli vs Leandro Pires
 Kick-off is moments away in Porto as Francesco Farioli's high-pressing Dragons look to pin back Leandro Pires' Estoril side from the opening whistle and extend their nine-game winning streak in Liga Portugal.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:21 PM ET 3 hours ago Dragão fortress vs Estoril's search for first away points
 At the 50,033-capacity Estádio do Dragão, FC Porto hold a flawless 4-0-0 home league record (9 goals for, 2 against), while Estoril have dropped all 4 of their away fixtures in Liga Portugal so far (2 goals scored, 7 conceded).
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:20 PM ET 3 hours ago Porto's bench
 For the game, Francesco Farioli will have the following players available during the match against Estoril: Cláudio Ramos, João Costa, Nehuén Pérez, Souza, Prpic, Francisco Moura, Gabriel Mec, Alan Varela, Hwang In-Beom, Seko Fofana, André Silva and Santiago Giménez.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:18 PM ET 3 hours ago Estoril lined-up!
 With a 4-2-3-1 formation, Estoril's starting lineup for the Liga Portugal match against Porto is: Turk, Andreou, Ferro, Sintes and Arolin; Parente, Tsoungui, Guitane, Peixinho and Carvalho; Lacximicant.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:17 PM ET 3 hours ago Porto lined-up!
 With a 4-2-3-1 formation, Porto's starting lineup for the Liga Portugal match against Estoril is: Diogo Costa, Alberto Costa, Bednarek, Kiwior and Sanusi; Froholdt, Pablo Rosario, Pepê, Gabri Veiga and Borja Sainz; Samu Aghehowa.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:12 PM ET 3 hours ago Liga Portugal's tightest defense meets bottom-placed Estoril
 Nine matchdays into the Liga Portugal campaign, perfect leaders FC Porto (9W-0D-0L, 27 points) boast the division's best defensive record with just 4 goals conceded alongside 21 scored (+17 goal difference), whereas 18th-placed Estoril arrive on 2 points (0W-2D-7L, 5 goals scored and 15 conceded).
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:08 PM ET 3 hours ago Good evening!
 We're starting the broadcast of the match, with all the action and excitement of the duel between Porto and Estoril, in this 10th round of the Portuguese League, with the ball rolling at the Estádio do Dragão, in a game between two teams from opposite sides of the competition!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:03 PM ET 4 hours ago Recent meetings between Porto and Estoril Praia
 Across their last 4 official meetings tracked on GioScore , the head-to-head record shows 4 wins for Porto, 0 draws and 0 wins for Estoril Praia: Estoril Praia 1-3 Porto (2026), Porto 1-0 Estoril Praia (2025), Estoril Praia 1-2 Porto (2025), Porto 4-0 Estoril Praia (2024).
 Updates by Victor Cunha
